channel.title: Potomac Local News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Potomac Local News (potomaclocal.com)

item.title: All Prince William Boil Advisories Lifted
item.description: A series of boil water advisories affecting multiple Prince William County neighborhoods has now been fully lifted, clearing residents to resume normal tap water use.

item.title: Leadership Shift in Manassas: Davis-Younger’s Departure Triggers Potential $50K-$100K Special Election, Interim Ties to Council
item.description: Manassas Mayor Michelle Davis-Younger announced today that she will step down two years early, on Dec. 31, 2026, as her final day in office.

item.title: Congress Funds Local Shelter, Housing Projects
item.description: Action in Community Through Service announced its long-closed West Safe House domestic violence shelter is one step closer to reopening after being included in a federal spending bill approved by Congress.

item.title: A Gaggle of Giggles: Stafford Mom Opens Silly Goose Imagination Village
item.description: A new imagination-based play space has landed in Stafford, created by a mom who saw a gap—and decided to fill it.

item.title: School Board Approves Elementary Redistricting Plan
item.description: The Prince William County School Board unanimously approved new elementary school attendance boundaries Tuesday night, finalizing a redistricting plan tied to the opening of new schools in the Woodbridge area.

item.title: Police pay deal adds $23 million in new costs
item.description: The police pay agreement approved by county supervisors will add more than $23 million in new costs over two years and require future boards to commit funding during the annual budget process.

item.title: Police Clear Gar Field After Report
item.description: Prince William County police conducted a precautionary search at Gar-Field High School in Woodbridge on Tuesday after unconfirmed reports that a firearm had been seen inside the building, ultimately finding no weapon and reporting no injuries.

item.title: Publix Is Coming — Just Not Close Enough for Dumfries
item.description: Prince William County officials said Publix is planned for Ashland Square, a long-discussed grocery project residents have tied to food access concerns in the eastern corridor.

item.title: Ethics Questions Follow Woodbridge Democratic Caucus
item.description: Ethics questions surfaced after a Prince William County supervisor briefly offered his government office as a potential ballot-counting site during a contested Woodbridge District Democratic caucus.
